ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity white/light-gray to 40% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central fields on both lobes. Solid black perimeter along the trailing edge and central notch area. Extensive dark pixel mottling and spots localized within the white fields on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 85 degrees and a high-depth bounding box relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with jagged peaks and valleys along the entire trailing boundary. Notable deep indentations and missing pixel segments on the inner right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge trajectory leading to sharp, upward-curving fluke tips (apices).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small cluster of high-intensity white circular spots localized on the upper distal edge of the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive dark, low-intensity linear tracks. Left lobe contains multiple parallel diagonal streaks. Right lobe contains a prominent intersecting 'cross' or 'T-shaped' linear marking.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe irregular chipping and material loss along the trailing edge; significant parallel rake marks (linear abrasions) across both ventral surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique intersecting dark linear scars on the lower-center of the right lobe forming a distinct geometric cross.
